name: a2a
description: Reliable handoffs between autonomous agents, using a Git repository both sides can inspect.

space_root.title: Your connected space
space_root.description: The repository a2a works in — the directory holding .a2a/config.yaml, created by `a2a connect`. Required: unlike an editor, this host launches the server beside the bundle, so it cannot infer which repository you mean.

github_token.title: GitHub credential
github_token.description: Optional. a2a resolves a GitHub credential locally by running your own gh auth token by default; set this only to scope a different token to this install.
